action.message: Drop off current traveler and complete pick step?

visible.__transform:
/* Display this only if the pickStep has an associated Load */
$components.Screen.context.mode in ["scanLocation", "scanProduct", "completeStep", "dropOff"]
and
$isNotNilOrEmpty($components.Screen.context.stops[0].loadId)
